props.name: children
props.comment: The fields to show. Each element is wrapped in a `<Labeled>`.

props.name: contentClassName
props.comment: Class names for the element wrapping this tab's fields.

props.name: label
props.comment: The tab label. Translated with itself as the fallback.

props.name: path
props.comment:
The URL segment under the show route. Defaults to the tab's index for
every tab after the first, and `""` (the show route itself) for the first.
